title: Autumn Clipart Fall Watercolor Clipart

description:
Welcome to Paper Artsthetics, I am super happy you’ve decided to get this Autumn time Clipart. What I have here for you is a unique transparent clipart downloadable for your crafts. Whether you’re embellishing a planner, junk journal, scrapbooking, or creating personalized stationery, these digital papers and clipart are designed to inspire creativity.

This is a digital product. You will not receive a physical product by any shipment. You will only have a digital product.
Some files may come in zip form. You can open the downloaded zip files with the “extract” command by right-clicking. Here is a list of important features of the file.

1 ZIP file

High quality 300 Dpi

Scrapbooking
Wedding decorations
Wallpaper

Invitation cards
